about_the_game:
Summary

You wake up in an empty forest in Ohio. A voice calls you. Says you're friends. Says you need to get out. But the signal keeps breaking, and so does your memory. Your friend will guide you from a distance, but he can't save you.

You have to hide from monsters that try to eat you and find your friend. You can help eachother and escape this place. You have a flahslight that works completely fine... most of the time. The caller will try to make you remeber him and your past, at least until...   - - - - -Signal lost

GAMEPLAY

You wake up alone in a dark forest with only a flickering flashlight and a voice on the phone that insists it’s your friend. Explore twisted streets, hide from unseen creatures, and follow (or ignore) the voice guiding you through the dark. Every step you take draws you closer to uncovering what the callers goal really is.

Key Features

  • Run and hide: Escape monsters that stalk you through dimly lit environments.

  • Unreliable light: Your only tool is a flashlight that flickers, fails, and leaves you guessing what’s in the dark.

  • Caller: A mysterious friend guides you, comforting, sarcastic, and familiar. Find him and escape this place together,

  • Branching responses: Listen, disobey, or challenge the caller to reveal different reactions and story details.

  • Atmospheric horror: Focus on dread and suspense rather than jump scares.

content_descriptors.notes: Some players may find the flesh-based monster designs unsettling or grotesque.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑7500 or similar
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑12400 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 730 or NVIDIA GT 1030 (GDDR5)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
